title: A customer question about Link Permissions and Expiry

question.author: member_076
question.body: I need a short answer about link permissions and expiry. What should I expect according to the official documentation?

answers.author: cloudbox_support
answers.body: The current Sharing Files and Folders documentation says: Expired links stop working immediately, and you can revoke any link at any time from the Shared links panel. Changing a file's permissions applies to every link that points to it. Links to folders inherit the folder's permissions. Share links can carry an optional expiration date and an optional password. That official page is the source to follow if a community reply describes an older version. Check the complete section there for surrounding conditions before applying it to your case.
